Refugee woman.firstEncounter:
The refugees flinch when you step close. Burned people always do. One of them, a broad woman with a seared forearm and hollow eyes, decides you look less dangerous than the alternatives.

"Ashfen," she says. "Upriver. Three days gone." She does not elaborate.

events.note: Gave a false name 'Davin' as a test; has ink-stained fingers and a heavy satchel; recognized Vex's scars with apparent concern at the name Calder

Celeste Emberveil.firstEncounter:
The figure stops. Doesn't run, which tells you something.

They turn. A woman, middle-aged, with ink-stained fingers and eyes that have done a lot of calculating in their time. No obvious weapons. The satchel hangs heavy, though.

Thessa Quelrath.firstEncounter: The Tallow Quarter earns its name. Candle-renders and knackers and three kinds of business that don't advertise. The streets narrow fast, the buildings leaning in like they're listening. Grease on the cobbles.

Rhett Lorrath.firstEncounter:
Celeste moves. Quiet, wide arc, cutting off the alley to the right.

Thessa doesn't follow.

Barkeep.firstEncounter:
The inn is called the Silt & Board. Nobody is proud of it.

Two rooms, hot broth, bread that was fresh sometime this week. The barkeep is a dwarf woman with a scar through one eyebrow and the particular incuriosity of someone who has learned not to ask names.

events.note: Delivered Sorn's letter at dawn without reaction to Vex's refusal — professional, unshakeable

Alwick Saltborn.firstEncounter:
Bold. Possibly stupid. Hard to tell yet.

The street is quiet. Pre-dawn quiet, the kind with weight to it. A carter somewhere, wheels on stone. A dog that has given up barking. The ash smell sits flat on the cold air.

You wait.

Three minutes. Five.

Then a boy, no, not a boy.

Knox Keldrun.firstEncounter:
He does not startle. Does not reach for a blade.

He looks at the flame in your palm for a long moment. Something moves behind his eyes. Not fear. Recognition.

"Marrowgate," he says. Voice like gravel dragged slow. "How many days?"

"Two," you say.

He closes his eyes.

Lorn Edenmire.firstEncounter:
They freeze.

Both hands on the bundle. The firelight catches the hood, catches the breath misting in the cold air. A long pause.

The Burning Man.title: The Burning Man
The Burning Man.desc: Find the man who walked out of the fire at Ashfen — alive if possible — and bring him to Watch Captain Wyndfall

objectives.text: Locate the burning man from Ashfen

lore: Village of Ashfen burned three days ago, upriver. Survivors describe controlled, deliberate fire from the Blighted Reach.
A man named Sorn owns significant debt in Marrowgate and operates from the Counting House on the main street.
Watch captain Theron Wyndfall keeps an office near the river gate.
The walking man from Ashfen is tall, lean, white-haired at the front, and headed into the Tallow Quarter. Fire bent toward him, not away.
Sorn knows the name Calder and claims to have met it in ledgers — he is aware of Vex's identity behind the Northlander alias
